title: Verdant Caldera: Narrative Mystery

foundation.history: The hanging botanical lab was built to protect mineral terraces, but geothermal plumes interrupted its stewardship.

premise: Tavi Lark, a investigator, must reconstruct an erased civic record using evidence synthesis while geothermal plumes threatens the hanging botanical lab.
central_conflict: a record-forging council seeks control of mineral terraces; residents want accountable access.

plot_beats.name: Arrival
plot_beats.cause: geothermal plumes isolates the hanging botanical lab
plot_beats.effect: Local routes and witnesses become inaccessible

plot_beats.name: The bargain
plot_beats.cause: a record-forging council offers privileged access to mineral terraces
plot_beats.effect: The player must decide whether to share information

plot_beats.name: The remedy
plot_beats.cause: The production plan determines who controls the restored system
plot_beats.effect: Faction trust changes the final public arrangement

endings.consequence: Stewardship passes to a representative public council
Resident cooperatives operate the recovered infrastructure
The essential route survives with unresolved governance debts
